title: Count unimodular row classes over a prime-power residue ring
statement: Let p be a prime natural number and a a positive natural number. Put R=ℤ/pᵃℤ. Let U={(r,s)∈R² | ∃x,y∈R, xr+ys=1}, and let P be its quotient by simultaneous multiplication of both coordinates by a unit of R. Then Nat.card P=pᵃ+p^(a−1).
lean_statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → Nat.card (Quot (fun v w : {v : ZMod (p ^ a) × ZMod (p ^ a) // ∃ x y : ZMod (p ^ a), x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : (ZMod (p ^ a))ˣ, (u : ZMod (p ^ a)) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : ZMod (p ^ a)) * v.1.2 = w.1.2)) = p ^ a + p ^ (a - 1)
